    About the project

    Evolution Residence is one of our most representative projects and a symbol of our success.

    The complex is a modern and recognizable residential space designed for individuals, families, and companies, with the goal of creating an exceptional environment for living, working, and leisure. Although still under construction, this unique project has already gained recognition due to high demand and dynamic sales.

    The high-quality apartments, business spaces, exclusive swimming pool, and a spa center will make the Evolution Residence complex the ideal place for living and working. The use of top-quality materials for finishing, combined with a beautiful location surrounded by greenery, will provide a high-quality living space with excellent connectivity to the city.

    INFRASTRUCTURE AND LOCATION

    The location is a critical factor when selecting the right property, and the quality of infrastructure is essential.

    The location of the Evolution Residence complex provides easy access to all key amenities. Within a one-kilometer radius, you will find kindergartens, primary and secondary schools, the Economics School, Singidunum University, as well as the "Stadion" shopping center and numerous dining establishments.

    Evolution Residence is located in Voždovac, at Tolminska St. № 5–11.

    The Evolution Residence complex is located in a carefully selected area, offering easy access to the city center while being situated in a peaceful green oasis. With a total area of 57,302 m², the complex will consist of four residential-commercial buildings.

    MATERIALS

    Top quality for complete enjoyment

    Aesthetics and Reliability in Every Detail

    The corridors and stairwells of the building are clad in elegant porcelain tiles, giving them a refined and modern appearance. Doors of domestic production are equipped with a Grade III anti-burglary system, ensuring a high level of security. The interior doors are faced with MDF and finished with melamine film, combining durability and aesthetic appeal. The flooring is made of three-layer oak parquet, complemented by white MDF baseboards with a height of 6/8 cm, creating a harmonious and stylish interior. Additionally, first-class ceramic tiles from a renowned European manufacturer are used, adding a touch of sophistication and comfort to the overall atmosphere.

    High Quality and Exceptional Comfort

    The facade of the building is clad with high-quality facing materials that boast excellent aesthetic characteristics. Modern terraces with geometric shapes add dynamism to the facade, while high-quality aluminum railings provide elegance. Aluminum blinds and mosquito nets enhance comfort. The building is equipped with a centralized heating system with remote control and energy consumption measurement through a calorimeter, as well as aluminum radiators and air conditioning to ensure an optimal indoor climate.

    FINANCING

    HOW TO BUY

    Credit

    Purchasing an apartment in the Evolution Residence housing complex can become a reality with the help of various banks offering favorable loans. Understanding the options available in the market will help you find the best solution for your financial needs.

    Buying an apartment with a loan is a practical solution that allows you to become a property owner without the need for large upfront investments. With a favorable mortgage, you can take advantage of the current market conditions and move into your new home quickly.

    Cash

    Purchasing an apartment in the Evolution Residence housing complex with cash can be an excellent choice for those who have the means. Paying in cash offers several advantages, including the ability to avoid interest payments and the convenience of a straightforward transaction process.

    This method not only simplifies the purchase process but also often provides more negotiating power, helping you secure the best possible deal on your new home.
